verdict.rationale: Modal's marketing says it can spin up "hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments" and "scale to thousands of concurrent runs", and a release note mentions an opt-in Sandbox backend with "substantially higher creation rates and concurrency". So large concurrent fleets are clearly a supported goal. However, no evidence shows documented concrete concurrency limits, quotas, or rate caps that a platform engineer could plan against. Missing for 10: documented per-account/workspace concurrency limits and sandbox creation-rate quotas, and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-fleet behavior.
